children: UFP Industries amended its revolving credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent and the participating lenders, extending the $750 million facility's maturity to October 23, 2031. The amendment raises the swingline loan and letter-of-credit sublimits to $75 million each and limits foreign-currency borrowings to swingline loans made by JPMorgan Chase. No cash borrowings were outstanding as of September 26, 2026, and approximately $42 million in letters of credit were outstanding.
